key.title: Get a free Groq API key
key.subtitle: It takes about 2 minutes

steps.1: Go to console.groq.com and create a free account (or sign in).
steps.2: Open "API Keys" from the sidebar and click "Create API Key".
steps.3: Give it a name, press create, and copy the key that is shown once.
steps.4: Paste it in your backend .env as GROQ_API_KEY — the frontend never stores it.

key.note: Security note: the API key is kept server-side. The frontend only stores the agent behavior settings below.

setup.title: How to get your bot connected
setup.hint: Sending notifications to a Telegram chat requires a bot token and your chat ID.

telegram.step1: Open Telegram and message @BotFather, then send /newbot and follow the prompts to create a bot.
telegram.step2: Copy the token BotFather gives you into the field above.
telegram.step3: Message your bot once, then use @userinfobot to find your chat ID.
